+def _dependency_solver(preference, name_order):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+        best = None
+        best_vector = None
+
+        def active(row):
+            return [dep for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                    if not dep.get("feature") or dep["feature"] in features]
+
+        def acyclic(versions):
+            edges = {}
+            for name, version in versions.items():
+                row = next(r for r in packages[name] if r["version"] == version)
+                edges[name] = [dep["name"] for dep in active(row)]
+            done, visiting = set(), set()
+
+            def visit(name):
+                if name in visiting:
+                    return False
+                if name in done:
+                    return True
+                visiting.add(name)
+                if any(not visit(other) for other in edges.get(name, [])):
+                    return False
+                visiting.remove(name)
+                done.add(name)
+                return True
+
+            return all(visit(name) for name in edges)
+
+        def search(constraints, chosen):
+            nonlocal best, best_vector
+            unresolved = [name for name in constraints if name not in chosen]
+            if not unresolved:
+                if not acyclic(chosen):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+                if (best is None or
+                    (vector > best_vector if preference == "maximum"
+                     else vector < best_vector)):
+                    best, best_vector = dict(chosen), vector
+                return
+
+            name = unresolved[0]
+            low, high = constraints[name]
+            rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                    if low <= row["version"] <= high
+                    and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+            rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["version"],
+                      reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+            for row in rows:
+                version = row["version"]
+                next_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                next_chosen[name] = version
+                next_constraints = dict(constraints)
+                valid = True
+                for dep in active(row):
+                    other = dep["name"]
+                    low, high = dep["min"], dep["max"]
+                    if other in next_constraints:
+                        old_low, old_high = next_constraints[other]
+                        low, high = max(low, old_low), min(high, old_high)
+                    if (low > high or
+                        (other in next_chosen and
+                         not low <= next_chosen[other] <= high)):
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    next_constraints[other] = (low, high)
+                if valid:
+                    search(next_constraints, next_chosen)
+
+        roots = {name: tuple(bounds) for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+        search(roots, {})
+        return ({"versions": best} if best is not None
+                else {"error": "unsatisfiable"})
+
+    return solve
+

 def _build_component_07():
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    def solve(data):
+        k = data["k"]
+        blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+        jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"] if job["id"] not in blocked]
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        best_ids = None
+        best_value = None
+
+        for subset in combinations(jobs, k):
+            ids = {job["id"] for job in subset}
+            if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+                continue
+            counts = {}
+            for job in subset:
+                group = job["group"]
+                counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+            if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+                   for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+
+            active_ends = []
+            valid = True
+            for job in sorted(subset,
+                              key=lambda row: (row["start"], row["end"], row["id"])):
+                active_ends = [end for end in active_ends
+                               if end > job["start"]]
+                active_ends.append(job["end"])
+                if len(active_ends) > 2:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+
+            value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+            selected = sorted(ids)
+            if (best_ids is None or value > best_value or
+                    (value == best_value and selected > best_ids)):
+                best_ids, best_value = selected, value
+
+        if best_ids is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+
+    return solve
+
